Agent Name: CodeExecutor
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The CodeExecutor incorrectly calculated the lifespans of both playwrights. For Edward Albee (born March 12, 1928, died September 16, 2016), the correct lifespan is 88 years and 188 days, but the code returned 77 years and 42 days. For J. M. Barrie (born May 9, 1860, died June 19, 1937), the correct lifespan is 77 years and 42 days, but the code returned 88 years and 188 days. The code output appears to have swapped the results for the two individuals, leading the Planner to draw the wrong conclusion that J. M. Barrie lived longer.
